Class Component

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.shipboard.Component
Direct Known Subclasses:
BasicComponent, ContainerComponent, SpecialComponent
public abstract sealed class Component extends Object permits BasicComponent, ContainerComponent, SpecialComponent
Represents an abstract base class for spacecraft components. Defines shared behavior and properties for all component types. This is a sealed class with permitted subclasses: BasicComponent, ContainerComponent, and SpecialComponent.

    • Component

      public Component(ComponentType type, int level)
      Constructs a new Component with the specified type and level.
      Parameters:
      type - the type of the component, representing its functional category
      level - the level of the component, representing its effectiveness or capability

  • Method Details

    • getLevel

      public int getLevel()
      Retrieves the level of the component.
      Returns:
      the level of the component as an integer.

    • getType

      public ComponentType getType()
      Retrieves the type of the component.
      Returns:
      the ComponentType associated with this component.

    • getFirePower

      public int getFirePower()
      Computes the firepower of the component based on its type and level. The firepower is determined for specific component types such as CANNON and DOUBLE_CANNON; for other types, the firepower is 0.
      Returns:
      the firepower value, which is equal to the level for CANNON and DOUBLE_CANNON types, or 0 for other types.

    • getEnginePower

      public int getEnginePower()
      Retrieves the engine power of the component based on its type and level. Returns a non-zero value only if the component type is ENGINE or DOUBLE_ENGINE.
      Returns:
      the engine power of the component; 0 if the type is not ENGINE or DOUBLE_ENGINE.

    • getTokenList

      public abstract ArrayList<Token> getTokenList()
      Retrieves the list of tokens currently associated with the component.
      Returns:
      an ArrayList of Token objects representing the tokens in the component.

    • getNumberOfTokens

      public abstract int getNumberOfTokens()
      Returns the total number of tokens present in the component.
      Returns:
      the count of tokens in the component

    • getNumberOfaToken

      public abstract int getNumberOfaToken(Token token)
      Calculates the number of occurrences of a specific token in the component's token list.
      Parameters:
      token - the specific token to count within the component.
      Returns:
      the number of occurrences of the specified token.

    • checkIfTokenIsValid

      public abstract boolean checkIfTokenIsValid(Token token)
      Validates if the given token is acceptable for the component.
      Parameters:
      token - the token to be validated
      Returns:
      true if the token is valid for the component, false otherwise

    • addToken

      public abstract void addToken(Token token)
      Adds a specified token to the component's token list.
      Parameters:
      token - the token to be added; must be a valid instance of the Token enum

    • removeToken

      public abstract void removeToken(Token token)
      Removes a specific token from the component.
      Parameters:

    • removeToken

      public abstract void removeToken()
      Removes a default token from the component. Specific behavior depends on the subclass implementation.

    • fillComponent

      public abstract void fillComponent(Token token)
      Fills the component with the specified token.
      Parameters:
      token - the token to fill the component with; must be a valid type for the component.

    • clearComponent

      public abstract void clearComponent()
      Clears all state and associated tokens from the component. Resets the component to an empty or uninitialized state.

    • getIsActive

      public abstract boolean getIsActive()
      Determines whether the component is currently active.
      Returns:
      true if the component is active, false otherwise

    • turnOn

      public abstract void turnOn()
      Activates the component, transitioning it to an operational state. Intended to be implemented by subclasses to define the activation behavior.

    • turnOff

      public abstract void turnOff()
      Deactivates the component, setting its state to inactive. Implementation details are defined in subclasses.
